items.title: Per sources, the Trendon Watford deal is a non-guaranteed minimum.
items.author: Shamit Dua
items.body_excerpt:
Per sources, the Trendon Watford deal is a non-guaranteed minimum.

There is a $250k guarantee, which moves up to $500k if he is not waived before the first day of the season.

The contract will be fully protected if not waived by Dec 30th.

This means he is the 15th roster spot.
